verification.title: Historical verification
verification.diffNoteHint: A note found in the data; not yet reviewed.

VERIFIED.label: Verified
VERIFIED.desc: Supported by reviewed and reliable sources.

DISPUTED.label: Disputed
DISPUTED.desc: Historical accounts or scholarly opinions differ.

UNCERTAIN.label: Uncertain
UNCERTAIN.desc: Insufficient evidence to establish the claim.

PENDING_REVIEW.label: Pending review
PENDING_REVIEW.desc: Not yet reviewed by a qualified reviewer; do not treat as verified.

IN_REVIEW.label: In review
IN_REVIEW.desc: A qualified reviewer is examining this record now; it is not verified yet.

NEEDS_REVISION.label: Needs revision
NEEDS_REVISION.desc: The reviewer sent it back for correction; it is not verified.

tr.pillPending: Original Arabic text – no approved translation
tr.draftNote: Draft translation, not yet reviewed; the Arabic original remains the reference.
tr.bar: {{n}} of {{total}} entries have an approved translation. For the others, the original Arabic text is shown.
tr.barDraft: Previewing draft translations – Draft – Pending Review. Not reviewed; the Arabic original remains the reference.

bio.journeyHint: Select a milestone to open it.
bio.sourceNote: Source references are at book or chapter level and have not been reviewed yet; check them in the original edition before citing.
bio.pageStatus: This whole page is pending historical review. The certainty labels show how the sources present each account; they are not verification.
bio.establishedDesc: Presented as established by the cited sources (review still pending).
bio.uncertainDesc: Details are uncertain or the reports vary.
